name: Add the Me-or-someone-else fork to family-intent onboarding
description: After an adult chooses the homework-support welcome path and creates their own identity, the app currently skips the learner-target decision and redirects into managed-child creation instead of the launch-relevant credentialed-learner invitation flow.
acceptanceCriteria: After family-intent signup creates the adult's own Person, present a plain-language learner-target choice: Me or Someone else. Me continues ordinary learner onboarding without creating family, guardianship, or supportership state. Someone else asks whether the learner has their own login; the launch path routes credentialed learners to the existing family-join invitation form, while any unavailable managed-child path is clearly gated rather than silently selected. The choice survives auth/profile remount and relaunch, remains non-authorizing, and has focused mobile tests plus a preview E2E proving the adult can reach the invitation form without first holding a supportership edge. Remove the current unconditional parent-intent redirect to /create-profile?for=child.
riskImpact: P1 activation gap: the primary adult acquisition path cannot reach the launch credentialed-learner invitation and instead enters a dormant managed-child flow.
